audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart is self-contradictory: content win[] (and the packet levelChart) say Level 2 goes to Thresh, Level 6 and 2+ items go to Maokai, and First item goes to Thresh, but full.phases[1,4,5,6].side all say 'Skill' — a flat template that never differed.
audit.why: Death Sentence (Q, 19s CD rank1) out-ranges Twisted Advance and peaks Thresh's combo at 2; Nature's Grasp (R) out-arcs the hook and can't be dodged in one sidestep at 6; his 21s (rank1) lantern (Dark Passage) buys the disengage window on first item; late, Maokai's reliable AoE lockdown outscales his skillshot playmaking.
audit.corrected: phases[1].side=Thresh, phases[4].side=Maokai, phases[5].side=Thresh, phases[6].side=Maokai, with ratings and why rewritten to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns already names Death Sentence's 19-second rank-1 cooldown correctly.
tradeGood/tradeBad are byte-identical template text shared across every matchup in this file and give no Thresh-specific interaction (his lantern shield, the mutual displacement race).
audit.why: Both sides carry displacement (Bramble Smash/Sapling Toss vs Death Sentence) — whoever lands first owns the trade; Dark Passage's shield absorbs the burst window a landed W buys.
